page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance split between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is relatively low, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Single-threaded tasks like gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also register in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, consistently rank in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also show average performance.

This hardware profile is suited for workloads that can leverage parallel execution across its 16 dedicated cores rather than relying on high single-thread performance. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, software compilation, and database operations, which all achieved average tier results in Passmark and Redis benchmarks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers dedicated physical cores and balanced memory density, making it a stable option for multi-threaded general-purpose applications, though it presents a performance tradeoff for single-threaded or memory-intensive tasks.
